fichas.title: Retail Sales Types and Typologies
fichas.summary: Overview of retail business and sales models. Open sales permit unrestricted entrance and exit; closed sales permit unrestricted entrance but require exit through a staffed checkout. Typologies include specialised shops and chains, self-service specialised supermarkets, department stores, and shopping arcades or centres.

A shopping arcade --7 0 is from 10,000 m2 in area, usually

courtyards.
A shopping centre/mall --7 Cli) is a larger and more elaborate
collection of retail outlets, eating places etc. It has fixed opening
times, therefore no semi-public access routes; main external access normally from only one road, but additional side access from

fichas.title: Shopping Arcade
fichas.summary: A shopping arcade is a roofed retail complex, generally arranged as a two- to three-storey street space with multi-level access. It has at least two external accesses and semi-public internal routes without fixed opening times. Smaller shops commonly line the internal street, while large-area chains may act as magnets at street ends or corners; routes may lead to squares or courtyards.

fichas.title: Shopping Centre / Mall
fichas.summary: A shopping centre or mall is a larger, more elaborate concentration of retail outlets and eating places. Unlike a shopping arcade, it has fixed opening times and no semi-public access routes. Its main external access is normally from one road, with possible additional side access from a car park or multi-storey car park.
